# Broker coverage

*Generated by `scripts/docgen/broker-coverage` from `internal/daemon/coverage.go`. Do not edit by hand: change the table and run `make docs-regen`.*

Canary reads one brokerage account through IBKR (TWS or IB Gateway) or through OpenD (moomoo, Futu). Most of what it shows is computed by Canary from what the broker supplies: the regime, portfolio stress, Edge and gamma are Canary's, not the broker's. So this page has two tables. The first says what each broker supplies. The second says how each capability runs on each broker and, where OpenD falls short, why. The same table decides what the daemon refuses under OpenD.

On OpenD, of 43 capabilities: 1 served, 8 partial, 19 unverified, 2 refused, 13 not served. Of those not fully served, 7 need data OpenD does not supply, 0 wait on a check of what OpenD supplies, and 8 have what they need from OpenD but are not yet read there.

## What each broker supplies

| Input | IBKR | OpenD | OpenD note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| session | supplied | supplied |   |
| account and positions | supplied | supplied | Trd_GetFunds and Trd_GetPositionList |
| intraday P&L | supplied | limited | today's P&L per position only (Trd_GetPositionList td_plVal, vendored), polled, at most 10 refreshed reads per 30 s per account; Trd_GetFunds carries no account-level daily P&L (its unrealizedPL and realizedPL are futures-only) and there is no P&L stream like IBKR's; Futu OpenAPI docs v10.12, openapi.futunn.com, read 2026-11-08 |
| quotes | supplied | limited | only in markets where the login holds the quote right; a subscription quota shared with other clients of the same OpenD |
| price bars | supplied | limited | a history quota counted over seven days |
| contract lookup | supplied | supplied | Qot_GetStaticInfo |
| ISIN listings | supplied | not supplied | no message takes an ISIN: a security is market plus code and Qot_GetSearchQuote (3262, not vendored) is documented for keywords only; Qot_GetCompanyProfile (3243, not vendored) returns a code's ISIN, the reverse direction, for equities and funds; Futu OpenAPI docs v10.12, openapi.futunn.com, read 2026-11-08 |
| option chains and Greeks | supplied | limited | Qot_GetOptionChain (3209, not vendored) lists a chain's contracts without quotes for HK stock, US stock, HSI and HHI underlyings, 30 days of expiries per call, 10 calls per 30 s, no expired chains; implied volatility, delta, gamma, vega, theta and rho per contract come from the vendored snapshot (Qot_GetSecuritySnapshot OptionSnapshotExData) or basic quote (OptionBasicQotExData), and option subscriptions draw on their own quota of 20 to 400 chains by account tier; Futu OpenAPI docs v10.12, openapi.futunn.com, read 2026-11-08 |
| bonds | supplied | not supplied | no quote or trade message serves a bond: the quotation and trading coverage tables list no bond contract in any market and no message page names bonds; SecurityType_Bond is only an enum value and Trd_GetFunds carries one aggregate bondAssets figure; Futu OpenAPI docs v10.12, openapi.futunn.com, read 2026-11-08 |
| broker statements | supplied | not supplied | OpenD has no statement service like IBKR Flex |
| borrow and fee data | supplied | limited | Trd_GetMarginRatio (2223, not vendored) returns per stock whether it is shortable, the short pool remaining in shares and today's borrow rate (shortFeeRate), for HK and US stocks only, 100 codes per call, 10 calls per 30 s; no rate history; Futu OpenAPI docs v10.12, openapi.futunn.com, read 2026-11-08 |
| earnings calendar | supplied | limited | Qot_GetEarningsCalendar (3401, not vendored) lists a market's reporters with date, session, EPS and revenue actuals and estimates, by market, watchlist or positions rather than by symbol, at most seven days per call, 60 calls per 30 s; IBKR's comes from Wall Street Horizon; Futu OpenAPI docs v10.12, openapi.futunn.com, read 2026-11-08 |
| quoted FX rates | supplied | not supplied | no message returns an exchange rate: the quotation coverage table marks Forex as not available to API users and Trd_GetFunds converts into the account currency without exposing the rate; Canary implies a rate from the account's own totals; Futu OpenAPI docs v10.12, openapi.futunn.com, read 2026-11-08 |
| order placement and preview | supplied | supplied | Trd_PlaceOrder and Trd_ModifyOrder; the preview is a maximum quantity (Trd_GetMaxTrdQtys), not a what-if |
| order and fill history | supplied | supplied | Trd_GetHistoryOrderList and Trd_GetHistoryOrderFillList |

## How each capability runs

Statuses: *served* works and a test or live check shows it; *partial* works with the gap named; *unverified* answers, but nothing has confirmed it on that broker; *refused* is reached and answers that it cannot; *not served* is refused by the daemon before any handler runs. Why not on OpenD: *broker* means OpenD lacks a needed input, *to verify* means that is not yet known, *Canary* means OpenD supplies what it needs and Canary does not read it there yet.

| Capability | Needs | IBKR | OpenD | Why not on OpenD | OpenD note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| status and data health | session | served | served |   |   |
| account | account and positions | served | partial |   | funds figures and currency conversion are tested on the simulator only |
| daily P&L | intraday P&L | served | unverified |   | Desk's moomoo page says it is not served; it answers on the simulator |
| positions | account and positions, quotes | served | partial |   | options, futures and other holdings are listed apart and left out of exposure and limit checks; tested on the simulator only |
| quotes | quotes | served | partial |   | only in markets where the login holds the quote right |
| price history | price bars | served | unverified |   |   |
| market display | quotes | served | unverified |   | the display stream was not probed |
| market overview | quotes, price bars | served | partial |   | prices the held names and the US ETF references from OpenD; OpenD gives no index or futures data, so those rows are named as missing and the overview reads partial; history is not followed for OpenD rows, so price bars are not drawn here; tested on the simulator only |
| portfolio allocation | account and positions, quotes | served | not served | Canary | reads the IBKR connector |
| market tape | quotes, price bars | served | not served | Canary | joins on IBKR contract ids |
| technical analysis | price bars | served | not served | Canary | reads the IBKR connector |
| option chains | option chains and Greeks | served | not served | Canary | reads the IBKR connector, as do the option picker and setup option discovery |
| recorded option chains | option chains and Greeks | served | unverified |   |   |
| gamma | option chains and Greeks | served | not served | Canary | reads the IBKR connector |
| bond lookup | bonds | served | not served | broker: bonds | reads the IBKR connector |
| breadth | price bars | served | partial |   | answers from breadth already stored, still labelled IBKR HMDS, and never refreshed; what it should say on OpenD is the owner's decision |
| regime | quotes, price bars | served | partial |   | reads HYG and SPY from OpenD; OpenD gives no index, currency or option-chain data, so the VIX term structure, USD/JPY and gamma rows are named as missing, and with two or more rows missing the headline stays "data incomplete"; a missing quote right is named too; tested on the simulator only |
| portfolio stress | account and positions, quotes, price bars | served | partial |   | composes from the OpenD regime, so its market context carries the regime's missing rows and its input health reads degraded; tested on the simulator only |
| macro | no broker data | served | unverified |   | reads no broker; the simulator tests run without macro sources |
| market calendar and events | no broker data | served | unverified |   |   |
| brief | account and positions, quotes | served | partial |   | names what OpenD does not serve and the holdings it does not analyse |
| Edge | broker statements | served | not served | broker: broker statements | built from broker statements, which OpenD does not provide |
| reconciliation | broker statements | served | not served | broker: broker statements | built from broker statements, which OpenD does not provide |
| statement reporting | broker statements | served | not served | broker: broker statements | built from broker statements, which OpenD does not provide |
| FX attribution | broker statements | served | refused | broker: broker statements | built from broker statements, which OpenD does not provide, so it answers with no attribution |
| borrow availability | borrow and fee data | served | not served | Canary | IBKR's borrow and fee data |
| earnings (WSH) | earnings calendar | served | not served | Canary | the earnings calendar comes through IBKR |
| cash sweep | quoted FX rates, bonds, order placement and preview | served | not served | broker: quoted FX rates, bonds | sizes orders from a quoted ledger rate, and OpenD's rate is implied |
| cash policy | no broker data | served | unverified |   |   |
| core sleeve | account and positions, quotes | served | unverified |   |   |
| core listing lookup | ISIN listings | served | not served | broker: ISIN listings | lists the listings IBKR knows for an ISIN |
| strategy | account and positions, quotes, price bars | served | unverified |   |   |
| setups | quotes, price bars | served | unverified |   |   |
| stock add plans | account and positions, quotes | served | unverified |   |   |
| rules, mandate and risk policy | account and positions, quotes | served | unverified |   | a holding in another currency without a sound rate counts as not measured |
| alerts | account and positions, quotes | served | unverified |   |   |
| proposals | account and positions, quotes | served | unverified |   |   |
| orders | order placement and preview | served | refused | Canary | Canary does not send orders through OpenD: place and manage orders in the Futu or moomoo app |
| order history | order and fill history | served | unverified |   | order and fill history are tested on the simulator only |
| option exercise | option chains and Greeks, order placement and preview | served | unverified |   |   |
| Desk authority and execution | order placement and preview | served | unverified |   |   |
| watchlist and holding locks | no broker data | served | unverified |   |   |
| settings | no broker data | served | unverified |   |   |
